scholarships.organization: Thurgood Marshall College Fund (TMCF) — Open Scholarships Portal
scholarships.description: Howard is a TMCF member school, so Mason can create a TMCF Scholar profile and get auto-matched to dozens of corporate-sponsored scholarships (Wells Fargo Access/Gap Scholarships, Acushnet Company Scholarship, and more) that rotate through TMCF's portal each cycle.
requirements: Attend a TMCF member HBCU (Howard qualifies)
Create a profile on the TMCF Scholarship Portal
Individual sponsor awards vary — filter by business/finance and sophomore standing once logged in
GPA thresholds vary by sponsor, typically 2.5–3.0+ (Mason's 3.7 clears most)
scholarships.deadlineNote: Confirmed: the 2026-2027 Wells Fargo Gap Scholarship (need-based, all majors, freshman–senior, 2.75+ GPA, up to $1,000) is open now and closes Dec 1, 2026 — the best current match since it isn't STEM-restricted. The separate Wells Fargo Access Scholarship (up to $10,000) opened June 1–July 17, 2026 but is STEM-majors-only, so not a fit for Finance. Additional sponsor scholarships rotate through the portal — recheck after Dec 1 for a new wave.

scholarships.organization: American Water Impact Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: $10,000 awards for non-medical STEM or business majors, with an HBCU/HSI-specific track. New Jersey is an eligible state, both as Mason's home state and as an American Water operating territory.
requirements: Full-time undergraduate in a non-medical STEM or business-related major
Minimum 3.0 GPA
Reside or attend college in an eligible state (NJ included)
HBCU/HSI track applies directly to Howard students
scholarships.deadlineNote: Re-checked Oct 2026: still listed closed/tentative for the next cycle with no official 2026-2027 dates confirmed yet, but search aggregators now cite March 25, 2027 as the expected deadline based on the historical application timeline. Treat as a best estimate and recheck scholarshipamerica.org/scholarship/american-water/ for the official open date (likely ~Jan 31, 2027 per prior years).

scholarships.organization: Executive Leadership Council (ELC) Scholars Program
scholarships.description: A network of Black corporate executives runs this flagship scholarship building a pipeline of Black business talent. Strong fit: it explicitly names "Rising Sophomore" as an eligible class year and prefers Business majors.
requirements: Full-time enrollment at an accredited 4-year college
Minimum 3.0 GPA
Rising Sophomore, Junior, Senior, or Graduate standing
Business, Engineering, or Technology major preferred
Need-based: FAFSA Submission Summary + tuition bill required
Essays, video prompts, business case responses, transcript, recommendation letter, resume
scholarships.deadlineNote: Annual deadline is typically March 1 (2026 cycle closed March 1, 2026, per the last review). The 2027-specific date wasn't separately re-confirmed this round — treat March 1, 2027 as the best estimate and watch elcscholarships.elcinfo.com for the official open date.

scholarships.organization: Howard University School of Business — Endowed Scholarships
scholarships.description: Howard's own School of Business administers 30+ donor-endowed scholarship funds (roughly $500–$10,000) for currently enrolled students, judged on financial need, academic excellence, and contribution to the field of study. This is a direct, Howard-specific opportunity in Mason's own school.
requirements: Currently enrolled Howard University School of Business student (Finance qualifies)
FAFSA on file for financial-need consideration
Apply via Howard's centralized AcademicWorks/Blackbaud scholarship application, released each January
Selection criteria vary by individual fund: need, GPA, essays, and field-of-study contribution
scholarships.deadlineNote: Re-checked Oct 2026: still no single exact deadline date confirmed across sources — the January-released, spring-reviewed pattern holds, and one weak aggregator still suggests April 15, unconfirmed. New this round: a direct contact was surfaced for current-cycle questions — Office of Student Affairs at 202-806-1663, or the Dean's Office at businessdean@howard.edu. Check HU email and business.howard.edu/office-student-affairs/endowed-scholarships starting January 2027 (the org's own site couldn't be fetched directly this session due to network access restrictions).

scholarships.organization: Maverick Scholarship (Howard University, via Bold.org)
scholarships.description: A donor-funded Bold.org scholarship restricted to Howard University undergraduates pursuing a business or related degree, aimed at students with entrepreneurial ambition. Open to freshmen through juniors with a 3.0+ GPA, which matches Mason's Finance major and class year exactly.
requirements: Enrolled undergraduate at Howard University
Freshman, sophomore, or junior standing
Pursuing a business or related degree (Finance qualifies)
Minimum 3.0 GPA
Essay on how your education will drive positive impact, plus a file showcasing a recent project
scholarships.deadlineNote: New for this update. Most recent cycle's deadline was April 5, 2026 (already closed, winners announced May 5, 2026). As a donor-funded Bold.org award, it's unclear whether it recurs on a fixed annual schedule — check bold.org/scholarships/maverick-scholarship/ periodically for a reopened cycle (bold.org couldn't be fetched directly this session due to network access restrictions).

scholarships.organization: Procter & Gamble HBCYOU Scholarship Program (via UNCF)
scholarships.description: P&G-funded, UNCF-administered need-based award of up to $2,500 for full-time undergraduates at any accredited four-year HBCU in the U.S. — eligibility is tied to HBCU status generally, not UNCF member-school status, so Howard qualifies even though it isn't a UNCF member school. Open to all class years including sophomores.
requirements: Full-time undergraduate at any U.S. accredited four-year HBCU (Howard qualifies)
Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA
U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or eligible immigration status
Demonstrated unmet financial need per FAFSA
Apply through the UNCF online application portal
scholarships.deadlineNote: New for this update. The 2025-2026 cycle deadline was Dec 15, 2025 at 5:00pm ET, and the program has run on this same Dec 15 date across the last several cycles — Dec 15, 2026 is a confident estimate for the next cycle, but confirm on the UNCF portal once it opens (uncf.org direct access blocked this session; found via UNCF-hosted program pages and aggregator listings).

scholarships.organization: Procter & Gamble General Scholarship (via UNCF)
scholarships.description: A $5,000 UNCF-administered award for undergraduates pursuing business, IT, or public-relations degrees — finance is explicitly a named eligible major. Open to all class years (freshman through senior/5th-year), a direct match for Mason's major even though it isn't HBCU-restricted.
requirements: Undergraduate pursuing a bachelor's degree in business, IT, or public relations (finance qualifies)
Minimum 3.0 GPA
U.S. citizen, permanent resident, or U.S. national
Demonstrated leadership involvement
Apply through the UNCF online application portal
scholarships.deadlineNote: Search results continue to disagree on the current-cycle window — one source described a Feb 9–Mar 9 window, another cited an April 25, 2024 deadline for the 2023-24 cycle — so no single date is confident enough to set. Confirm the live window directly at scholarships.uncf.org (blocked from direct fetch this session).

scholarships.organization: NABA National Scholarship Program (National Association of Black Accountants)
scholarships.description: NABA's foundation funds 150+ scholarships a year ($2,500–$10,000) for Black/minority undergraduates in accounting, finance, or business — one of the best-matched programs for Mason's major.
requirements: Ethnic minority undergraduate business major (finance qualifies)
Paid NABA member for the current fiscal year
Overall GPA of 3.3+ (3.5 for accounting majors) — Mason's 3.7 clears this
Full-time enrollment (12+ semester hours), freshman through first-year senior
Selection weighs academic achievement, leadership, service, and engagement with NABA
scholarships.deadlineNote: Updated Oct 2026: a fifth search (collegexpress, unigo, bigfuture aggregators) again converged on the same Jan 15–Feb 26 window first surfaced Oct 1, 2026 — now the most consistently repeated of the four candidate windows found across sessions (vs. single mentions of Mar 15, late June, and Dec 31). Set to Feb 26, 2027 as a best estimate for the next cycle on that basis, but nabainc.org and my.nabainc.org remain blocked from direct fetch every session without exception — verify directly on nabainc.org/scholarships/ before relying on this date. Renew NABA student membership — required before applying — well ahead of time regardless.

scholarships.organization: Congressional Black Caucus Foundation — CBC Spouses Education Scholarship
scholarships.description: CBCF's flagship undergraduate award for academically talented Black/African American students. Howard/DC sits in a CBC member's district (Rep. Eleanor Holmes Norton), which likely satisfies the district-residency requirement.
requirements: U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident
Reside or attend school in a CBC member's congressional district (Howard/DC likely qualifies)
Full-time undergraduate, graduate, or doctoral enrollment
Minimum 2.5 GPA
Demonstrated leadership and community involvement
2-part online application, 3-minute video statement, 1 recommendation letter, transcript, resume
scholarships.deadlineNote: 2027 cycle deadline found via search aggregators as March 27, 2027, matching the recurring Jan–Mar window (2026 cycle ran Jan 5–Mar 27, 2026). CBCF's own site (cbcfinc.org) could not be directly verified this session due to network access restrictions — double-check there closer to the date.

scholarships.organization: National Black MBA Association (NBMBAA) Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Funds undergraduate and MBA scholarships ($1,000–$10,000) for Black students in business fields. Likely requires junior standing, so this is a bookmark for Mason's 2027-28 junior year rather than right now.
requirements: Paid NBMBAA membership
College junior, senior, or MBA student (rising sophomores likely not yet eligible)
Pursuing a business-related degree
Full-time enrollment, U.S. citizen or permanent resident
Community service/leadership involvement
scholarships.deadlineNote: Not yet eligible as a rising sophomore — revisit for junior year; 2026 deadline was May 29. Checked again this round: some individual NBMBAA chapters (e.g., Atlanta, Los Angeles) run their own undergraduate scholarships that do accept college sophomores, but those are geographically tied to their chapter regions, which Mason has no connection to — not added. Worth revisiting if a NJ/DC-area NBMBAA chapter turns out to run a similar local program.

scholarships.organization: LeCount R. Davis, CFP® Endowed Scholarship (CFP Board Center for Financial Planning)
scholarships.description: A scholarship specifically for Black/African American students pursuing CFP® certification. Requires enrollment in a CFP Board Registered Program — confirm whether Howard's finance curriculum has this track before applying.
requirements: Self-identifies as Black or African American
Enrolled in (or seeking) a CFP Board Registered Program
Demonstrated merit and financial need
Committed to pursuing CFP certification and a financial planning career
scholarships.deadlineNote: 2026 cycle notified award decisions by email on June 5, 2026, implying an application window earlier in spring 2026; 2027 cycle dates not yet published. Still contingent on Mason enrolling in (or Howard offering) a CFP Board Registered Program — confirm with Howard's finance department before investing time. cfp.net could not be directly verified this session due to network access restrictions.

scholarships.organization: Aspiriant Impact Scholarship (CFP Board Center for Financial Planning)
scholarships.description: A CFP Board scholarship for students from populations underrepresented in the financial planning profession (including by race/ethnicity) who are enrolled in a CFP Board Registered Program, offering up to $10,000 for undergraduate-level candidates. Runs in parallel to the already-tracked LeCount R. Davis Scholarship but isn't restricted to Black/African American applicants specifically.
requirements: From a population underrepresented in financial planning (by gender, race/ethnicity, disability, or sexual orientation)
Enrolled in (or committed to enroll within 3 months of winning) a CFP Board Registered Program — confirm whether Howard's finance curriculum has this track
U.S. citizen or permanent resident; not in final semester at time of application
Not a prior recipient of a CFP Board Center for Financial Planning scholarship
scholarships.deadlineNote: New for this update. The 2026 cycle's deadline was Sept 30, 2026 (closed just before this review); Sept 30, 2027 is an estimate for the next cycle based on that recurring annual date. Still contingent, like the LeCount R. Davis scholarship, on Mason enrolling in (or Howard offering) a CFP Board Registered Program — confirm with Howard's finance department before investing time. cfp.net could not be directly verified this session due to network access restrictions.

scholarships.organization: SEO Career (Sponsors for Educational Opportunity)
scholarships.description: Not a cash scholarship, but a highly-regarded paid internship and professional-development pipeline for high-achieving Black, Hispanic, and Native American undergraduates targeting Wall Street and finance careers. Interns average $10,000 for the summer with ~80% converting to full-time offers.
requirements: Undergraduate (rising sophomores through rising seniors typically apply)
Black, Hispanic, or Native American identity
Interest in finance, Wall Street, real estate, or related corporate tracks
Competitive application: resume, interviews, assessments
scholarships.deadlineNote: Confirmed rolling, year-round admissions — no fixed deadline. Apply directly at career.seo-usa.org; earlier is better since cohorts fill on a rolling basis.

scholarships.organization: INROADS Internship Program
scholarships.description: A paid internship (not a scholarship) placing Black, Hispanic, and Native American college students into corporate roles, with many finance/business placements — a useful funding complement now that Mason is internship-eligible as a rising sophomore.
requirements: Full-time undergraduate with at least one summer remaining before graduation
Minimum cumulative GPA of 2.8
Business is a named target field
INROADS-formatted resume, unofficial transcript
Completion of INROADS Interview Guidance and Preparation Session (IGPS)
scholarships.deadlineNote: Rolling admissions overall, but priority consideration goes to complete applications submitted by Nov 1 (fall-cycle applicants) or Mar 1 (spring-cycle applicants); applications after those dates are still accepted on a rolling basis. Apply directly at inroads.org for current regional/corporate-partner openings.

scholarships.organization: 100 Black Men of America — National Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: Awards of $1,000–$5,000 for full-time college undergraduates. Eligibility appears restricted to 100 Black Men mentees, Collegiate 100® members, or program affiliates — worth connecting with a local NJ chapter to qualify.
requirements: 100 Black Men mentee, Collegiate 100 member, or affiliate
Full-time college undergraduate
Minimum 2.5 GPA
scholarships.deadlineNote: National program historically reopens each January with a deadline the following February (the 2025-26 cycle followed this pattern); exact 2026-27 dates not yet published. Award access is chapter-gated — Mason would need to affiliate with a local 100 Black Men chapter or Collegiate 100 chapter (check chapters near his NJ hometown) before applying.

scholarships.organization: Howard University Alumni Club of New Jersey (HUAC-NJ)
scholarships.description: The Howard alumni club serving New Jersey runs mentorship and scholarship efforts for Bison students — a natural, high-affinity fit given Mason is both an NJ resident and a Howard student.
requirements: Likely NJ residency and/or Howard enrollment
Specific criteria not published — contact the club directly
scholarships.deadlineNote: Unknown — reach out to the club directly for current opportunities. No new information found this round; still worth a direct outreach attempt.

scholarships.organization: Community Foundation of New Jersey — Scholarship Universal Application
scholarships.description: CFNJ administers roughly 140 separate scholarship funds for NJ students through one universal application; some funds support business/finance-track or continuing (non-senior) students.
requirements: Typically requires NJ residency or NJ high school graduation
Eligibility varies by underlying fund
Some funds are renewable/open to continuing college students
scholarships.deadlineNote: Varies by fund — CFNJ's universal application portal typically opens each spring for the coming award cycle. No specific 2027 dates were published as of Sept 2026 (cfnj.org could not be directly verified this session due to network access restrictions) — recheck cfnj.org/find-scholarships/ in early 2027.

scholarships.organization: Financial Planning Association (FPA) Diversity Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for financial-services students actively promoting diversity within the financial planning profession.

Demonstrated engagement raising awareness of financial planning in diverse communities, or expanding opportunities for underrepresented groups in the field
GPA/class-year requirements not detailed — verify on FPA's site
scholarships.deadlineNote: No new deadline information found this round; recent recognitions occurred in September, suggesting a mid-year cycle. Confirm current dates directly on financialplanningassociation.org.

scholarships.organization: CFA Institute Student Scholarship
scholarships.description: Not a cash scholarship, but a significant CFA Program exam fee reduction (from roughly $1,200+ down to $600) for university students — useful to know about now for when Mason eventually pursues the CFA charter.
requirements: Current full-time or part-time university student
Must meet CFA Program enrollment requirements
Not currently registered for a CFA exam, not awaiting results
scholarships.deadlineNote: Confirmed: the Student Scholarship application window opens Sept 1, 2026 and closes July 15, 2027 (long open window, apply anytime before then). A separate, need-based Access Scholarship runs quarterly windows tied to each exam sitting (e.g., the Aug 2027 exam window opens Nov 3, 2026 and closes Nov 23, 2026) — check cfainstitute.org for whichever fits when Mason is ready to sit for Level I.

scholarships.organization: Horatio Alger National Scholarship
scholarships.description: A large, well-established scholarship ($25,000 awards) for students demonstrating financial need and resilience. Eligibility for currently-enrolled sophomores versus only incoming freshmen is ambiguous in published materials — verify directly before applying.
requirements: Household AGI roughly $55,000–$65,000 or lower (varies by source)
Minimum 2.0 GPA
U.S. citizen
Co-curricular/community service involvement, demonstrated integrity and perseverance
Verify whether continuing college sophomores qualify — some tracks may be HS-senior-entry only
scholarships.deadlineNote: Re-checked this round: the main National Scholarship's continuing-sophomore eligibility remains unconfirmed (materials still read as HS-junior/senior entry, Dec 1–Mar 1 window). A separate Horatio Alger Career & Technical Scholarship does explicitly list "College Sophomore" as eligible, but it's restricted to certificate/trade/associate-degree career-technical programs, not four-year business/finance bachelor's degrees — confirmed not a fit for Mason and not added separately. Contact horatioalger.org directly to ask whether the main National Scholarship has any continuing-student track.

scholarships.organization: Scholarships360 $10,000 No-Essay Scholarship
scholarships.description: Easy-entry scholarship open to any student, no essay required, with rolling monthly winners — low odds but zero-cost and takes minutes to enter.
requirements: Any U.S. student
No essay, no GPA minimum specified
scholarships.deadlineNote: Confirmed still active and rolling as of Sept 2026, with monthly winners. Apply anytime at scholarships360.org — low odds but no cost.

scholarships.organization: Sallie Monthly Scholarship for College Sophomores
scholarships.description: A $2,000 monthly scholarship specifically open to college sophomores — directly matches Mason's current class year, no essay or profile required beyond simple entry.
requirements: Enrolled college sophomore
No essay required
scholarships.deadlineNote: Confirmed active as of Sept 2026; the current program cycle runs through 12/31/2026 with monthly drawings. Apply anytime at sallie.com — takes only a couple of minutes.

scholarships.organization: Goldman Sachs Scholarship for Excellence (SFE)
scholarships.description: A diversity-recruiting scholarship for Black, Hispanic, and Native American undergraduates that pairs a paid Goldman Sachs summer internship with up to $15,000 toward tuition and academic expenses once the internship begins. Sophomore or junior (penultimate-year) standing, full-time enrollment at an accredited college
Minimum 3.4 GPA
Open to all majors; interest in finance/business preferred
Apply through the Goldman Sachs Careers events portal (450-word essay, 2-minute video, or slide presentation) and secure a GS summer internship offer to receive the award
scholarships.deadlineNote: Reconfirmed Oct 2026: applications open Nov 1, 2026 and close Jan 1, 2027, unchanged from the prior review. Exact deadlines can vary slightly by school/recruiting event, so confirm via goldmansachs.com/careers once the portal opens.

scholarships.organization: Morgan Stanley Richard B. Fisher Scholarship Program
scholarships.description: A $15,000 scholarship for Black, Hispanic, Native American, and LGBT sophomores and juniors, awarded alongside a Morgan Stanley summer internship offer. Open to all majors and a direct match for Mason's class year, though the scholarship application is only unlocked after applying to an open Summer Analyst position.
requirements: Black, Hispanic, Native American, or LGBT identity
Sophomore or junior standing at an accredited four-year institution
Minimum 3.0 cumulative GPA
Open to all majors
Must first apply to a current Summer Analyst opening via Morgan Stanley's Students & Graduates page; scholarship application follows from that
scholarships.deadlineNote: New for this update. Tied to Morgan Stanley's rolling Summer Analyst recruiting windows rather than one fixed date — sources cite differing round deadlines (e.g., late June, early October, early November) depending on division/track. Watch morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/students-graduates for the Summer 2027 Analyst postings, likely opening fall 2026.

scholarships.organization: JPMorganChase Fellowship Program
scholarships.description: Not a cash scholarship, but a paid, five-week summer fellowship for undergraduate sophomores that leads to consideration for a full summer analyst internship the following year. Unlike many bank diversity programs, JPMC states it is open to students of all backgrounds, with tracks spanning Commercial & Investment Bank, Global Markets, Corporate Function, and more.
requirements: Rising sophomore (or current sophomore) at time of application, open to all backgrounds
Preferred minimum 3.2 GPA
Open to all majors; finance/business interest fits the Commercial & Investment Bank and Global Markets tracks
Apply online via JPMorganChase's careers site during the fall application window
scholarships.deadlineNote: New for this update. The 2026 cohort's application deadline was Jan 12-13, 2026 (already closed); Jan 12, 2027 is an estimate for the next cycle based on that pattern. Watch jpmorganchase.com/careers/explore-opportunities/programs/jpmcfellowship starting around November 2026 for the official 2027 posting.

scholarships.organization: Southern California Personal Injury Lawyer Scholarship
scholarships.description: A $1,000 scholarship from a Los Angeles personal injury law firm, open to any student enrolled at an accredited U.S. college or university. The check is paid directly to the winner to use on school expenses or tuition.

Apply only through the online form on the firm's scholarship page
Don't call or contact the firm about the scholarship
scholarships.deadlineNote: The 2026 cycle's Sept 30, 2026 deadline has now passed as of this update. The firm's posted cutoff is October 1 each year, so Sept 30, 2027 is the estimated next-cycle deadline based on that recurring pattern. The winner is contacted by phone and announced the following month.

scholarships.organization: Social Change Fund United (SCFU) Scholarship for HBCU Business Students

A strong, direct match for Mason as an HBCU Finance major.
requirements: Undergraduate or graduate student at a Historically Black College or University (Howard qualifies)
Enrolled in a business-related major (Finance qualifies)
Essay on economic empowerment, business innovation, and social equity in underrepresented communities
No class-year restriction specified
scholarships.deadlineNote: New for this update. Apply via bold.org; recheck thesocialchangefund.org/scfu-highlights/scfu-scholarship closer to the date.

Directly matches Mason's class year and major with no race/ethnicity or geographic restriction.
requirements: Sophomore, junior, or senior standing at a U.S. college or university
Pursuing a field related to finance
Short essay on passion for finance and how to improve the financial system
scholarships.deadlineNote: New for this update. The 2026 cycle's deadline was July 5, 2026 (already closed, winners announced Aug 6, 2026); July 5, 2027 is an estimate for the next cycle based on that pattern since it recurs annually on Bold.org. Apply at bold.org once the next cycle opens.
